body.deadline_description: Final pay on separation (RSA 275:44): If termination occurs during or shortly after promotion, ensure final paycheck includes all wages earned at promoted rate from effective date forward. No hold-back allowed; all wages due within 72 hours of discharge.

body.rule: Non-compete enforceability check (RSA 275:70-a, RSA 329:31-a): On hiring or role change, system must: (a) Calculate employee hourly wage (or annualize if salary); (b) If ≤$14.50/hour (200% federal min), flag any existing non-compete clause as VOID and unenforceable; mark in system as unenforceable; (c) If employee is physician or dentist, flag all non-compete clauses (regardless of wage) as likely VOID per RSA 329:31-a; (d) On promotion affecting wage, recalculate threshold and update enforceability status (e.g., promotion across $14.50 threshold may activate enforceability).
